entities.summary: Kliment Arkadievich Timiryazev, sometimes Timiriazev was a Russian botanist and physiologist and a major proponent of thought of Charles Darwin in Russia. He founded a faculty of plant physiology and a laboratory at the Petrovskoye Academy.
